## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Spain. It starts at s/n,Calle Chacona.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Did you know Tenerife has its own pyramids? Although they're not as mighty as their Egyptian cousins, these manmade mountains are still a sight to behold, and equally shrouded in mystery. Now you can uncover their secrets for yourself, and learn all about their history and excavation in the Ethnographic Park, the museum and exhibition, before exploring the beautiful botanical gardens.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €13.28. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 100 ratings and 67 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
